integrity: The equilibrium, characteristic polynomial, positivity of \(D\), monotonicity derivatives, and the contradiction at \(C_k=1\) were independently reconstructed from the printed equations and replayed symbolically. The argument is exact and does not infer an infinite statement from finite simulation. The stated publication date is the date printed on the source article.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the source's three-dimensional CKD-only affine subsystem with the constant noncommunicable hazard \(\lambda_k\). It does not classify the full seven-compartment COVID-19--CKD model or models with prevalence-dependent kidney-disease incidence.
title: A constant CKD hazard has no positive-threshold bifurcation
